semantic_label: walk index probe: descend the four level category, page and entry arrays and answer whether any entry slot has a leaf

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x14
abi.return_contract: a byte in AL; the answer is only the low byte

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: read the root list at +0x0c and reject when the outer index at +0x10 reaches the four byte distance between the root list end and begin shifted right by two
resolve the category through 0x005c5de0 and skip to the page level when the middle index at +0x14 reaches the category array span
resolve the page through 0x005cae30 and break when the inner index at +0x18 reaches the page array span
resolve the entry list through 0x005c1ce0 and answer true when the leaf index at +0x1c is below the entry span
increment the inner index, clear the leaf index and loop while the inner index is below the page span
increment the middle index, clear the inner index and loop while the middle index is below the category span
clear the middle index, then walk the category's own page list and increment the outer index when it is exhausted
answer false once the outer index reaches the root span

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the four cursor words and the root pointer
0x005c5de0, 0x005cae30 and 0x005c1ce0 are dependency-only ports, so the descent is unverified in this package
the four level array shapes are opaque; only the offsets and the four byte span arithmetic are pinned
the four cursors are mutated in place and are never restored, so the runtime caller contract is unverified
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation collapses the two page level loops into one; the assembly has a distinct inner loop reached through the page list and a second loop that walks the category's own page list after the middle index is cleared, so the corrected model keeps both
the decompilation compares the entry span with a signed compare; the assembly builds the span as a four byte difference shifted right by two, so the model uses the shift
